recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-fairness: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.pass:q-fairness: an independent page-free reader (22-locks-semaphores q2), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-fairness: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'a'
recorded.because:q-fairness: no cue decides it: all three options share the same 'X goes next, and Y' shape and length; c's 'reentrancy' only morphologically echoes 'ReentrantLock', too weak to single it out

recorded.prompt:q-fairness:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-fairness:b: an independent reader (22-locks-semaphores q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-fairness:b: ruled out: 'Fair vs. Non-Fair' list: barging and potential starvation describe the Non-fair (default) lock; 'Fair: Longest-waiting thread gets the lock next. No starvation'
recorded.prompt:q-fairness:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-fairness:c: an independent reader (22-locks-semaphores q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-fairness:c: ruled out: 'Fair: Longest-waiting thread gets the lock next' (not the owner); reentrancy is described as a property of ReentrantLock regardless of fairness
recorded.prompt:q-await-loop:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-await-loop:b: an independent reader (22-locks-semaphores q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-await-loop:b: ruled out: Condition Objects: 'the waiting thread is re-awakened and must re-acquire the lock before returning from await()' - the lock is retaken inside await(), so the loop re-check already runs with the lock held; Q3 A3 gives the loop's reason as spurious wakeups: 'A thread may return from await() without signal() being called. Always guard with while(!condition)'.
recorded.prompt:q-await-loop:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-await-loop:c: an independent reader (22-locks-semaphores q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-await-loop:c: ruled out: Common Pitfalls #4 'Calling await() without holding the lock': 'cond.await(); // IllegalMonitorStateException' / 'must hold the lock before calling await()' - a thread cannot enter the wait without the lock.
